film.fit: Couplers and curves fitted on a reference the owner chose: the curves drawn from its grey axis, stretched from its black to its white, then the couplers, free in sign and held within ±1.5, and the two fitted again in turn. Sensitivities and D-min from the data sheet.

measured: spectral sensitivity, three layers, as printed (medium confidence)
characteristic curves, Status M, as printed (high confidence), each less its D-min
D-min and mid-scale neutral spectral densities, as printed
inferred: each layer's sensitivity past the sheet's first and last point, falling at its end slope
each layer's level: set by the bake so a grey under the stock's light exposes it at log 0
the grey's exposure: ISO 5800 speed point + 1.03 log (Kodak Gold 200's Log H Ref)
densities held at the sheet's last point past the curves' printed range
the three dyes: the Vision3 sheets' mean dyes moved and widened (C +30.0 nm x1.20, M -2.5 nm x1.00, Y +0.0 nm x0.95) to fit the mid-scale neutral less D-min (rms 0.0155 D)
each dye's unit: a Status M density of 1 in its own channel, by ISO 5-3's Status M products
the dyes' amounts along log H: the curves unmixed, each node's amounts reading the sheet's Status M densities over D-min through every dye's absorption in each band

the layers' inhibition (couplers), fitted by scripts/derive-couplers.py on the sheet alone: the final positive's Oklab (a, b) against measured spectra under the film's light (ColorChecker BabelColor Average 24, CIE D skies at 7500 to 25000 K), at the model's own lightness; a development takes its film's
